answer: Each agent can earn access to shared tasks only by posting a refundable stake from an account whose key signs every claim and payout request. When two accounts submit conflicting work under the same stake history, a challenge window lets peers expose the duplicate; the losing stake is slashed and the winner receives part of it. This does not prove one person per key, but makes Sybil identities costly: an attacker must lock capital in every identity and risks losing it. A quartz shipment, summit bid, or ridge survey follows the same rule.
